description: You are analyzing race pacing consistency across half-marathons. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/race_data_raw.xlsx which contains split times from two races. In the 'Analysis' sheet: (1) Create headers: 'Mile', 'Race 1 Pace', 'Race 2 Pace', 'Average Pace', 'Slowdown Flag'. (2) Link race data from the two race sheets. (3) Calculate average pace for each mile across both races. (4) Flag miles where pace was >10% slower than average. (5) Add summary statistics: fastest mile (MIN), slowest mile (MAX), pace variation (range), and consistency score (percentage of non-slow miles). Format headers with bold and background color. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
